turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided to give my son a zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
You need an answer? I asked you a question first.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admits what, exactly, and on what evidence? Nothing goes on his transcript for a first concern; check your own procedure. Answer my question, Hale, or we finish this in the principal's office.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
No. Show me what you have.
